title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode14 Vivids!

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: You were out late again, Toya. I was starting to get worried. Your father was waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Do you have any idea what time it is?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: You were over on that street playing that garbage music again, weren't you?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: How long are you planning on wasting your time, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: If you spent half as much time practicing as you did messing around, you could have been competing at the national level already.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm not messing around.
And no matter what you say, I'm not going back to playing classical music.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
What a waste.
I can't believe how far you've been dragged down by a single bad influence.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Dad, Akito's got nothing to do with this!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Akito's been serious for a long time. He's been working towards his goal of surpassing RAD WEEKEND ever since he saw it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm nothing like him... I would have done anything as long as it wasn't classical...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Saying you're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND isn't something you can say half-heartedly.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Akito... I'm the one with weak resolve.
I...shouldn't be the one up there with you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Time to put your money where your mouth is.
Let's see what you can do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Careful what you wish for.
We've come prepared with our best song yet!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, and just make sure you don't pull some cowardly stunt like last time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tsk. As if I'd stoop that low.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We're on first today.
Let's show them what real talent is. Hey, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're BAD DOGS! Thanks for coming tonight!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I knew those two were good, but they seem on a completely different level tonight. When did they improve so much?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (So why bother messing with the power like they did?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Never mind that. Right now, I need to focus.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your turn. Not going to let us down now, are you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Just you watch.
I expect you both to be in the front row.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Come on, Kohane!
Let's go give them a taste of our best song!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Way more than last time...
The air is so thick with energy that it's hard to breathe...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'd be lying if I said I wasn't scared. But right now...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't worry, Kohane. I'm right here with you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Today is the day we take our first step toward surpassing RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I still remember that feeling I got the day I first heard An singing at Weekend Garage.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I want to give everyone that same feeling!
I want them all to feel same rush!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Let's do this, Kohane! Together, we can do anything!)

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line:
This is the first time I've heard these two.
They're pretty good. What did they call themselves? The Vivids?

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: One of them is Ken's daughter, so I've heard of her, but the other one's got a voice on her too. What? They're still going?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I thought so. Those two are the same as you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Don't you think it's about time you just admitted it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're the Vivids! Did everyone enjoy the show?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We may be new at this, but one day we're going to throw an event that'll surpass even RAD WEEKEND! We hope you'll be there to support us!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Akito, Shiraishi, and now Azusawa...
They're all putting everything on the line to chase their dreams.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I'm... I'm the only one who's different...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is as far as I go...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well? You finally convinced about Kohane's ability?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why do you sound so proud of yourself?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I admit, it looks like you may have the resolve after all.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So let me ask you this. Are you two actually serious about surpassing RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your song was great. Sorry about messing things up before.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh? That was easier than I expected.
Could it be that you're actually more honest than I thought?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, shut up. If that's all, then get out of here already.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, yeah. Oh, but before we go.
You two weren't half bad yourselves. Good job, Akito, Toya♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Come on, Kohane! Let's go get changed.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So full of themselves.
Hey, Toya. We're going to need to change up the set list for the next event.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're going to put on a performance that'll make them regret ever messing with us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't perform with you anymore.
